free_tier.stated: Opossum 1 1 TB, Opossum 2 1 TB, Polar Bear 2 TB, Killer Whale 3.5 TB, Horse 3 TB, Penguin 4 TB, Mammoth 8 TB; the 4-20 TB tier adds Chimera Hybrid 4 TB / 8 TB / 16 TB at 4-16 TB of HDD plus NVMe. RAIDZ2 on HDD, Montreal CA.

egress.terms: Two options per plan, switchable in the control panel. Option 1 (the one that matters): 'Unlimited transfer — 250 Mbps port, grows +1 Mbps/day up to 1 Gbps'. Option 2: '10 Gbps port — 12TB 1Gbps monthly cap (throttled to ~10 Mbps after cap)'. So the truly unmetered option is speed-clamped at 250 Mbps and slowly ramps, and the fast option is a 12 TB cap that degrades to ~10 Mbps rather than billing overage. The provider states traffic is counted on BOTH directions (LET thread 199994 p9: 'We count traffic from both d[irections]').

tooling: rclone SFTP, any backup tool, Xen/KVM root
chaining: Root VPS; AList/MinIO installable. The 250 Mbps unlimited option is the single most valuable egress term found — it is genuinely uncapped, just bandwidth-shaped.
limits_note: per-object-cap: none. 'Unlimited Expanding Storage' plans add +1 to +15 GB/day of disk rather than granting it up front. Xen on the older storage line.
reliability_note: Long-standing CA provider with a strong LowEndTalk record — 'Have been using servarica for close a year now. Absolutely no issues' (thread 180949), 'I just renewed my storage vps with servarica for the 2nd year never had issue'.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
